gibbs.def: Gibbs free energy, G; its change ΔG = ΔH − TΔS combines enthalpy and entropy into one test of whether a process is favored. ΔG° is the value under standard conditions.

favorability.def: A process is thermodynamically favored when ΔG < 0: it can proceed on its own, without a continuous input of energy, though possibly very slowly.
